info.name: Bejeweled Conclave Spy
info.description: The Bejeweled Conclave Spy background from Arcana Unleashed.

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Disguise Kit, Fine Clothes, Perfume, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: Publicly, you're a courtier, a mediator, or an entertainer. But behind that glamorous visage is a mind honed for gathering secrets. Trained by the enchanters of the Bejeweled Conclave, you know how to use your charm and wit (plus a little magic) to infiltrate organizations, uncover information, and broker deals.

setters.set: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma, Arcane Eloquence Feat, Deception and Perception Skills, and Disguise Kit
